title: Recertification Route Allowance — Hardship and Protective Holds
content:
Under Hardship and Protective Holds, when an updated physician's medical or disability certification is asked for on a running Long-Term Hardship Hold, a certification route allowance is added once to the days allowed for the recertification. It depends on how the physician's certifications on the hold have arrived — only documentation submissions of that kind count.

| How the physician's certifications on the hold have arrived | Certification route allowance |
|---|---|
| At least one by mail or fax, and none by the online portal or email | 5 calendar days (certification paper allowance) |
| At least one by mail or fax, and at least one by the online portal or email | 2 calendar days (certification mixed allowance) |
| Otherwise | None |

## Truth table

| Certifications by mail or fax | Certifications by portal or email | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 1 or more | 0 | 5 days |
| 1 or more | 1 or more | 2 days |
| 0 | 1 or more | None |
| 0 | 0 | None |

**Reading.** Income records or any other kind of documentation received on the hold do not enter this test, whatever channel they used.

**Example (hypothetical).** The hold's certifications arrived once by fax and once by mail, and the consumer's income records arrived by email. Only certifications count; all arrived on paper, so 5 calendar days are added.
